lines.4: 「Of course. We're trying to study on our own, so they're a real nuisance.」
lines.5: 「By the way, Konoe, I have two things I want to ask you.」
lines.7: 「First. I have twelve little sisters... and one of them writes novels as a hobby.」
lines.8: 「She asked me to read one and tell her what I thought, but I'm not sure how I should judge it.」
lines.9: 「I'd like the opinion of the drama club's writer.」
lines.10: 「Just tell her what you honestly think. Judge it without personal feelings and without mercy. That's only fair.」
lines.13: 「Of course. But don't just say it's boring. Tell her what parts were boring.」
lines.14: 「If the shock makes her unable to write again, then that's as far as she was going. A writer has to use frustration as a springboard and get back up.」
lines.17: 「Nishizaki spotted a rare bird from the window and ran outside to photograph it. Should I allow that?」
lines.18: 「You should've said that first! Obviously not!」
lines.20: 「Koo! (I got a great shot of a Matsukasa kite!)」
lines.23: 「Leaving the classroom when it isn't even break time...」
lines.30: 「I demand you hand over the culprit!」
lines.31: 「Now I feel like I'm being scolded too. What a predicament.」
lines.34: 「...Wait, Noriko. Did you scrape your knee?」
lines.35: 「Ah, this... chasing the bird... I fell...」
lines.39: 「Come on. I'll patch you up, so let's go. And don't run off on your own again.」
lines.42: 「Nao... one way or another... you're kind.」
lines.44: 「I'm not happy just because you say something like that.」
lines.45: 「Your face is red. For someone named Sunao, you're not very sunao.」
lines.46: 「No name puns! That seriously pisses me off!」
lines.47: 「Sounds like some people are making a racket out in the schoolyard.」
